name: Desk Set
tagline: Time, rhythm, a table and two faces to read them in.
description:
The things that sit at the edge of a desk rather than at the centre of the work: a stopwatch that records laps, a metronome that holds a tempo, and a table view for whatever delimited text has just landed in the clipboard.

Two drawn faces come with them. The seven-segment face sets the stopwatch and the metronome the way a physical one would be set; the block face gives a terminal the eighth blocks and box rules that meet exactly, which is what a sparkline in a status line needs.

Five packages, about a hundred and twenty kilobytes together.
